name: jwt_inspector
description: Browser-native JWT inspector. Parse header and payload, check expiry, and optionally verify HS256/RS256 signatures. All computation in WASM — keys never leave the browser.

tools.name: parse_jwt
tools.description: Decode a JWT token's header and payload without verifying the signature. Returns the decoded header, claims set, and signature.

tools.name: check_expiry
tools.description: Check whether a JWT token is expired. Returns expiry status, time to expiry, and human-readable expiry time.

tools.name: verify_hs256
tools.description: Verify a JWT's HS256 (HMAC-SHA256) signature using a shared secret key. All verification runs locally in WASM.

secret.description: The shared secret key used to sign the token.

tools.name: verify_rs256
tools.description: Verify a JWT's RS256 (RSA-SHA256) signature using a PEM-encoded RSA public key. All verification runs locally in WASM.

public_key_pem.description: PEM-encoded RSA public key (-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY----- ... -----END PUBLIC KEY-----).
